TO: Dr. W. F. Gannon DATE: July 11, 1979
FROM: J. E. Wickham
SUBJECT: HTI 2415/5089
Submitted By: P. Gauvin
2415 = MPBC = Red 045 and Black H58 = Control Marlboro 85 Cigarettes
5089 = MPBD = Red H58 and Black 045 = Experimental "Macho II" 85 Cigarettes

The experimental "Macho II" 85 cigarettes (M9BD) were different from the control Marlboro 85 cigarettes (M9BC) in the following characteristics: tar and nicotine deliveries, total RTD, static burning time, filter length and weight, filter dilution, tobacco weight, and rod density.

The standard 25 mm cork tipping used on Marlboro 85 cigarettes was replaced with a 32 mm cork tipping to be similar to that of the "Macho II" 85 cigarettes.
